particulars.title: Meeting webcast / recording
particulars.summary: The City's council meeting video archive: meetings live-streamed and kept on the City YouTube channel, linked from the meetings gateway page. Titles carry the date and start time (e.g. 'City of Waterloo Council Meeting December 8, 2025 @ 2:00PM'); afternoon and evening sessions on one day are separate videos. The sampled Dec 8, 2025 video is the whole meeting (3 h 18 min) with YouTube auto-captions only. It establishes what was said, in what order and roughly when. It does not by itself establish the formal decision record: items are called by number ('item four'), names are mis-transcribed, and votes are announced by voice ('carried unanimously'), so the minutes (P015) stay authoritative.
particulars.primary_reason: Video and its transcript are a direct record of proceedings (observed on the Dec 8, 2025 sample).

secondary.reason: Gateway link and channel listing are navigation.

particulars.role_note: Adds G3 for the gateway and channel listing. D1 is now observed on one video; it records proceedings but is not the official minutes.
particulars.parsing_note: Listing: a title regex recovers date and start time (40/40 titles in the sampled listing). Transcript: the YouTube transcript panel renders a timestamped ASR transcript in a browser; captions are machine-generated, not edited. Dec 8 sample: 19 'all those in favor', 19 'carried', 10 'moved by', 14 'seconded'; items referred to by number; one councillor surname spelled three ways. Use the minutes as the key for agenda-item alignment and take motion text and results from the minutes, not the ASR. Scripted caption requests (timedtext) came back empty and yt-dlp was refused; the rendered panel is the working route. Archive start date not established (listing sampled back to Sep 2025; 2016 titles use an older pattern).
particulars.evidence_detail: 2026-11-14 browser re-check: City gateway page 200; channel 'Live' listing read (40 most recent streamed meetings, Sep 22, 2025 to Nov 2, 2026); Dec 8, 2025 video (YouTube IPFBIBH-OcU) opened in headless Chrome: playable, 3:18:04, streamed 18:55-22:17 UTC, English auto-generated captions only; full transcript panel read (1,517 timestamped segments, 0:35-3:17:48, about 31,600 words). particulars.summary: 'GRT Performance Dashboard' (Power BI) embedded on GRT's 'Ridership and performance' page, which carries the definitions. Page 2 'Service Reliability' gives monthly on-time percentage from January 2021 (e.g. 2025 annual 74% for bus at the 3-minute threshold), with slicers for the 3- or 5-minute threshold and service type. Stamped 'Latest Update: June, 2026'. It establishes GRT's own published performance figures under its stated definitions; it does not establish their accuracy, and figures can change without a version record.

Both routes need a browser session or the undocumented API; no documented export was seen. Slicer combinations (measure x service type x threshold) multiply the views; only defaults were read. Check run: monthly ridership cells sum to the shown annual total for all 8 years, within 0.02M rounding.
